stances_toward.note: The Malvinas claim: Argentina claims the islands, which Britain controls. The claim dates back to 1833; 1982 (the war) is the sourced date here, not the start of the claim. Milei reaffirmed it in 2026 and London says sovereignty is not up for negotiation (99.8% of islanders voted to remain British in 2013, per the GBR card). Bond - grievance: the 1982 war.

relations_to.summary: Argentina claims the Falklands/Malvinas. Milei reaffirmed the claim in April 2026 and at the UN in September 2026, and said in December 2025 that arms-export talks with London had begun, which the Foreign Office denied; London says sovereignty is not up for negotiation.
